CustomField.description: Points to the master Lead when this record is identified as a duplicate. Set manually when the Duplicate Flag__c is true. The master record is the one to progress for qualification; this record should be set to Status = Duplicate.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The lead to keep when this record is a duplicate. Set this to point to the correct lead, then set Status to Duplicate on this record. Sales should work the master record only.
CustomField.label: Master Record
